claim_text: Capture-SELEX isolate 1d04 binds glutamate with Kd 12 µM in the indexed abstract.
notes: VoR closed. Do not transfer onto glu1 or Hu Glu-apt.

claim_text: Truncated surface-bound glu1 E-AB reports LOD 0.0013 pM by ACV in the indexed abstract.
notes: Different construct from 1d04. Matrix of LOD vs serum selectivity not separable from abstract.

claim_text: Kd and LOD in Wu 2022 are not interchangeable affinity numbers.
notes: Load-bearing interpretation. Confirmed as construct split by citation auditor.

claim_text: Hu 2025 glutamate MEA channel LOD is 32 pM in PBS and 51.5 pM in 50% serum.
notes: Double-extracted from OA PDF. Not Wu 0.0013 pM.

claim_text: Hu 2025 glutamate electrochemical apparent Kd is 1.8 nM (Langmuir-Freundlich), distinct from cited 12 µM solution value.
notes: Authors note 2D confinement. Not solution Kd.

claim_text: Hu 2025 glutamate assay uses 15 min incubation before ACV.
notes: Cannot support millisecond neurotransmission.

claim_text: No glutamate aptamer kon/koff were found in inspected glutamate sensor papers.
locator: Round 2 search of glutamate sensor sources
notes: Absence of evidence across S001/S002/S010/S021. Tobramycin IPA and mixed-aptamer ITC must not be substituted. source_id S001 is the primary glutamate aptamer paper searched, not a kon measurement.

claim_text: Surface-bound tobramycin aptamer IPA: kon 3.5e4 M^-1 s^-1, koff 1.39 s^-1, Kd,kinetic 41±11 µM.
notes: Not glutamate. Shows IPA can measure surface kon/koff when mass transport is controlled.

claim_text: IPA interrogation can be 2 ms; that clock is measurement_time not binding koff.
notes: Do not equate 2 ms interrogation with synaptic 1.2 ms cleft clearance.

claim_text: Small-molecule aptamer ITC survey: both kon and koff change with Kd (kon 2e5 to 96 M^-1 s^-1; koff 1.03e-3 to 0.012 s^-1 over Kd 28 nM to 864 µM).
notes: Abstract only; VoR closed. Not glutamate. Per-construct tables not inspected.

claim_text: Inferred peak cleft glutamate 1.1 mM decaying with tau 1.2 ms at cultured hippocampal synapses.
notes: Kinetic inference not chemical assay. VoR closed.

claim_text: Ambient extracellular glutamate in hippocampal slice is about 25 nM by tonic NMDAR current.
notes: Auditor: not an extrasynaptic-only measurement. Contrasts cited dialysis 1-4 µM.

claim_text: A 1:1 Langmuir isotherm spans 81-fold between 10% and 90% occupancy (c10 = Kd/9, c90 = 9 Kd), independent of Kd.
notes: Theoretical Langmuir 10–90% identity as stated by Rousseau. The withdrawn overlay that one Kd cannot cover 25 nM tonic and 1.1 mM cleft is not this claim; those concentrations are C012/C011, not measured in Rousseau, and are not transferred here.

claim_text: Xiao 2025 glutamate SPR Kd is 293 nM while FET practical LOD is 10 fM in 0.1x PBS.
notes: Buffer is 0.1x PBS. Response stabilize 200 s. Not in vivo.

claim_text: DNA tetrahedron display of Apt48 increased N-protein fiber signal 2-2.5 fold and halved apparent fiber Kd vs Apt48 alone.
notes: Interface evidence. Not glutamate.

claim_text: InstructNA generated some stronger SPR binders than top-frequency HT-SELEX clones for LOX1/CXCL5, but most generated sequences were not strong binders.
notes: Hypothesis-generating for glutamate. Not a glutamate aptamer.

claim_text: Predicted aptamer structures and docking scores failed to recover experimental theophylline vs caffeine selectivity.
notes: Primary computational benchmark vs crystals; experimental selectivity is cited not remeasured.

claim_text: E-AB packing density and SAM chemistry change signal gain and apparent Kd (cocaine/thrombin).
notes: Not glutamate. Immobilization is not a null operation.

claim_text: Park 2023 table row labeled Glutamate FET is Plasmodium falciparum GDH (Singh 2019 PMID 30308419), not neurotransmitter glutamate.
notes: Citation auditor: supports_claim=no for using Park as Glu NT sensor evidence.

claim_text: No verified in vivo glutamate aptamer sensor among Round 1-2 sources; in vivo aptamer FETs demonstrated for serotonin and dopamine.
notes: Scope limit not a measured glutamate negative result. S066 is in vitro mouse retina, not in vivo. Serotonin/dopamine FETs remain the in vivo aptamer examples in this ledger.

claim_text: Hu 2025 lists Glu-apt Kd = 12 µM citing Wu 2022; that value is a citation, not a Hu remeasurement of the Fc-thiol truncated surface construct.
construct: Glu-apt sequence as used by Hu, Kd label from Wu citation
notes: Do not collapse this 12 µM with Hu electrochemical apparent Kd 1.8 nM.

claim_text: Rutherford 2007 cites GlutOx MEA coating response time 500-800 ms (Burmeister 2000/2002) and states freely moving data were recorded at 1 s intervals.
notes: Enzyme comparator. Cited coating response_time is 500-800 ms (Burmeister VoR not re-opened in the enzyme audit). Do not treat 500-800 ms as this paper's wet t90 versus 1.2 ms. Still not synaptic milliseconds.

claim_text: Clay 2018 reports a simulated GlutOx response time of 0.73 s matching experimental 0.8 ± 0.2 s.
notes: Simulation plus cited experiment. The experimental match 0.8 ± 0.2 s is Clay's citation (Wassum VoR unopened in the enzyme audit). Not synaptic milliseconds. Round-2 hunter had incorrectly said 0.73-0.8 s was absent.

claim_text: Published iGluSnFR fluorescence time courses are often characterized as 10-100 times longer than the extracellular lifetime of synaptically released glutamate.
locator: Europe PMC full text XML PMC7255799
system: literature comparison inside a primary paper
notes: Authors characterize previously published time courses against an uptake-derived estimate. Not a new wet measurement in this paper. Buffering mechanism is C035.

claim_text: iGluSnFR buffering of glutamate diffusion and delayed uptake is established by Monte Carlo simulation (Figure 2C,D).
notes: Split from C024. Simulation labeled as simulation. Not an aptamer kinetic. E039 already flags simulations as in paper.

claim_text: Abrantes 2025 preprint abstract claims 1 aM glutamate LOD in aCSF on a graphene FET with computationally designed NG-Apt-Glu.
notes: Preprint. In silico design. Do not enter unverified ELONA millimolar Kd. Not a substitute for kon/koff.

claim_text: Hu 2025 Glu-apt sequence is a truncated Fc- and thiol-modified oligo; authors themselves contrast electrochemical apparent Kd with cited solution-phase values because of 2D confinement.
construct: surface Glu-apt vs cited solution Kd
notes: Supports construct/interface non-transfer. The confinement explanation is the authors' interpretation.

claim_text: For 1:1 Langmuir occupancy, the concentration ratio between 10% and 90% occupancy is exactly 81, independent of Kd (c10=Kd/9, c90=9 Kd).
locator: algebra; Rousseau 2023 states the same identity
notes: Rousseau is not sole evidence. Implemented and tested in analysis/accepted/occupancy_kinetics.

claim_text: Hu 2025 RWTH thesis: 10 nM glutamate signal on the Glu-apt intraretinal probe plateaus at approximately 10 min.
notes: Not a fitted koff. Distinct from the journal MEA 15 min Glu wait (C006).

claim_text: Hu 2025 thesis probe glutamate LOD is 0.3 pM on the 1 nM-1 mM PBS calibration.
notes: Not Ames. Not in vivo. Different format from journal MEA 32 pM (C004).

claim_text: Hu 2025 thesis Ames-medium glutamate calibration is linear from 10 nM to 10 µM and the authors report poor quantitative SNR versus PBS.
notes: Buffer composition changes performance. Mixed nM/µM span stored in value. E044: authors report 41.6% blank noise in Ames. Printed log-slopes are now E047 (PBS 11.86 %/decade, Fig. 6.7B) and E048 (Ames 57.11 %/decade, Fig. 6.9A). Those two buffer curves do not invert tissue ACV to concentration or occupancy.

claim_text: Hu 2025 thesis records ACV in in vitro mouse retina at 14 s/scan then 1 min sampling; the authors interpret this as basal glutamate, not synaptic transients.
construct: Glu-apt on PaC probe in retina
notes: Strongest Glu-apt neural-tissue experiment in this ledger. Not in vivo. Does not fill C007. Author basal reading is interpretation, not a pharmacological identification. Probe 3 showed an early plateau but reported gold-nanostructure detachment confounds its interpretation; PaC occupancy is unmeasured. Probe 4 unstable. Value is the 1 min sampling interval; 14 s is the scan clock (E045).

claim_text: Hu 2025 thesis selectivity panel compares 100 nM glutamate with 10 µM serotonin, dopamine, tyrosine, and lactate; aspartate and glutamine are not in that panel.
notes: Does not license amino-acid cleft selectivity. Empty value is intentional (no ratio reported).

claim_text: Hu 2025 thesis records ACV (signal_gain) on a Glu-aptamer PaC probe in in vitro mouse retina in two legs: post-insertion baseline rise under initial light-on, and later light-on/off correlation (Probes 1-2 authors p < 0.05; Probes 3-4 ns). Authors interpret the current as basal glutamate, not synaptic transients.
notes: E046. Two MEASURED ACV legs; analyte identity UNKNOWN on both. The section 6.3 successful-detection sentence is author interpretation, not a second assay. Probe 3 showed an early plateau but reported gold-nanostructure detachment confounds its interpretation; PaC occupancy is unmeasured. Probe 4 unstable. Not a pharmacological identification. Not in vivo. Empty value is intentional.

claim_text: Hu 2025 thesis places the glutamate ACV recording on the large bottom electrode at the GCL of in vitro mouse retina on the same probe as spike recordings.
notes: E045. Does not by itself resolve IPL-border versus photoreceptor-terminal narrative. Value is the 14 s scan clock already in E045.
